messages: maya: quick design drop for the stream pane — compact header with a token chip + action cluster. attached image. thoughts on label wording and screen reader behavior? design-bot: uploaded image stream-pane-compact-v1.png :framed_picture: sam: engineering notes up front: - token counter currently updates per batch (~250ms) which causes repaint. recommend throttling to 800-1000ms and fixing width to avoid layout shift. - 'Stop' currently triggers an abort signal; if we change label to 'Pause' or 'Interrupt' semantics need to match (pause implies resumable). emily: copy suggestions: - avoid ambiguous verbs. prefer 'Interrupt' (explicit) or 'Cancel' (terminal). - long tooltip for screen readers: "Interrupt generation — preserves last partial output" - token label: "Tokens used: 1,234" (explicit) and short visible hint: "Shown for transparency" liam: a11y considerations: - streaming text should be wrapped in aria-live="polite" but throttled so SRs aren't spammed. - token chip must not be in the tab order if it just reflects state; add aria-hidden="true" for the visual chip and expose a separate sr-only element that updates less often. - contrast for the chip should meet 4.5:1; if chip is small text, aim for 7:1. maya: UX question: when user hits Interrupt do we keep the partial text editable or lock it while regenerating? sam: implementation preference: keep partial text visible and place a subtle overlay with a spinner and label "Interrupting" or "Regenerating". do not auto-clear. easier and safer from a UX standpoint. emily: microcopy proposal to finalize: - primary action: "Interrupt" - secondary: "Regenerate" - token tooltip: "Tokens used in conversation" - sr text updates: on completion and every 50 tokens (configurable) liam: +1. also add a completion live-announcement: "Response complete" (polite). for long streams, add a user setting to enable continuous announcements. maya: mini checklist for PR: - debounce token updates to 1s, fix width, visible chip aria-hidden=true, sr-only live region updated on completion/50-token milestone (sam) - change label to Interrupt + i18n keys and tooltips (emily) - add aria-live polite for stream and completion announcement, document tests (liam) - preserve partial output during regenerate with spinner overlay (sam) sam: snippet I'll include in the PR for the sr-only region: ```html 1,234 Tokens used: 1234 ``` emily: I'll push the i18n keys and the tooltip strings. short note: use conservative wording for translations: "Interrupt generation" for clarity. liam: I'll draft the a11y test cases and add steps: keyboard focus order, live region throttling verification, color contrast check, screen reader sanity with VoiceOver/NVDA. maya: great. decision: label = Interrupt, token chip visible but sr-announcer controls speech cadence, preserve partial output on regen. updating the mock and will post v1a. :thumbsup: design-bot: uploaded image stream-pane-compact-v1a.png :framed_picture: sam: thanks — will open PR today and ping for reviews. emily: Copy committed to i18n branch. liam: QA checklist in docs ready for review. maya: closing thread for now. reopen if anything pops during implementation.
